annotations.text:
LIGHT

Accent #0F7A8F — Samarkand tilework teal. Deliberately not Telegram blue.

Used only for: unread badge, outgoing bubble, send button, active toggle. Nothing else.

TYPOGRAPHY

Golos Text — Latin + Cyrillic drawn as one family.

Both Uzbek marks are correct here:
U+02BB in oʻ / gʻ (Toʻrayev, Gʻayrat)
U+02BC in aʼzo (Aʼzamova, maʼlumot)

Most apps collapse both to a straight quote.

DARK

True #000000 for OLED — real battery saving, and bubbles float instead of sitting on grey.

Accent lifts to #45BBD4 to keep contrast; outgoing bubble drops to a deep #0E5361 so it never glares at night.
The compose bar is the whole product argument: input + send. No paperclip, no mic, no sticker button. Nothing that opens a media parser.
